services.name: Fall Fishing
services.desc: Summer fishing in South Florida is defined by warm water, consistent bait, and steady action. This is the time of year when schools of bait hold around the reefs and offshore edges, allowing us to fish actively and cover less ground. Launching from Dania Beach, we’re close to areas that produce well throughout the summer months. Compared to winter, summer fishing is generally faster-paced, with more frequent bites and a wider mix of species. It’s a good season for families, beginners, and groups looking for steady activity while staying close to shore. 4 Hour Trip A solid option during summer.
